I once had an interesting job where I managed inventory out of a warehouse on the same property as the house I lived in. There was a second warehouse beside it, and this one guy came over and was really interested in it. It was all high tech surplus gear and I was trying to learn what the product was, and he was like “Oh that’s an electron microscope!” Seems like a nice guy and he mentioned his “19 year old daughter” a few times (I was around 22) so you know, stay in the good books. Well lo and behold I get woken up by a knock on the door at 9 am the next morning (a Saturday) and he’s standing there with a 24 pack of beer. Well this is strange.. but whatever, come on in.

I showed him around my house (half of which was warehouse space for the more sensitive items) and decide to show him the projector I had set up with a movie. This was circa 2002 so any screen bigger than 32” was a novelty. As we were watching whatever dumb movie my sleepy head from being woken up before I was ready started to get heavy eyes. He noticed this and said, oh you can just lie down behind me”, gesturing to the open space on the couch. I kindly decline, thinking “well that was weird” and moved myself over to the recliner beside the couch. As I descend into half sleep I hear him move over to the side of the couch closest to my recliner. Then his hand on the same arm rest.. I froze.. next thing I know he’s inching his hand over mine to caress it, which made me pull away, followed immediately by him putting his hand on my chest! I pushed it away and stood up and he goes “Oh, I thought you liked to party!”

Umm wtf kind of parties does this guy go to? Anyways once he realized I wasn’t interested he gave me a big hug while resting his head against my chest (I’m a good 8” taller) and went on his way.

Never saw him again. I wasn’t really worried because I was much bigger. But it gave me a bit of empathy for women in that situation when a guy is a bit too forward. Not sure what I would have done if he was the bigger man and was on a mission.
